item.text: {"summary":"Fix ASCII whitespace splitting to recognize carriage returns","explanation":"The failing regression shows that `Split.ByAsciiWhitespace` treats `\\r` as a field instead of a separator. Update the ASCII whitespace predicate to include carriage return while preserving its existing behavior for other characters.","edits":[{"path":"absl/strings/internal/str_split_internal.h","old":"c == '\\n' || c == '\\t' || c == '\\v' || c == '\\f'","new":"c == '\\n' || c == '\\r' || c == '\\t' || c == '\\v' || c == '\\f'"}]}
